title: From Drawing to Decision
steps: PDF, CAD and BIM inputs become the starting point for project information.
Measure quantities from project information with traceable workflow context.
Organize quantities into a structured bill of quantities.
Apply pricing and estimating logic to build a project estimate.
Connect commercial scope and contract workflows.
Connect required items and commercial procurement workflows.
Carry project information into delivery and site workflows.
Capture progress and project reporting signals.
Connect progress, commitments and cost information.
Turn project information into reports and management views.
Use connected project intelligence to support decisions.
